g.text: Welcome to the Flower Anatomy interactive module!
Your task is to correctly identify and label
the major parts of a flower by dragging the
word bank labels to their corresponding
1. Review the flower diagram on the left
2. Examine the word bank at the bottom
3. Click each label to select it, then click
4. Use the Hint button if you need help
5. Click Check Answer to verify your work
• Stamen is the male reproductive part
• Pistil is the female reproductive part
• The receptacle supports the flower parts
Word Bank - Click and drag labels to their correct positions
© 2024 Educational Module • Flower Anatomy • Static SVG Learning Interface
Need help identifying the flower parts? Here are some clues:
Clue 1: The colorful parts that attract insects are...
Clue 2: The green leaf-like structures at the base of the flower are...
Clue 3: The male reproductive organ consisting of anther and filament is...
Clue 4: The female reproductive organ consisting of stigma, style, and ovary is...
Clue 5: The part that produces pollen is...
Clue 6: The stalk supporting the anther is...
Compare your labels with the correct positions below:
Petal: The large, colorful structures at the top
Sepal: The green structures at the base of petals
Stamen: The male reproductive organ (yellow parts)
Pistil: The female reproductive organ (purple center)
Anther: The pollen-producing tip of stamen
Filament: The stalk supporting the anther
Ovary: The swollen base of the pistil
Style: The stalk connecting stigma to ovary
Stigma: The sticky top of the pistil
Receptacle: The base supporting all flower parts
10 correct: Excellent! You know flower anatomy well.
7-9 correct: Good job! Review a few details.
4-6 correct: Fair. Study the diagram more closely.
0-3 correct: Keep practicing! Use the hint button.
Are you sure you want to reset the activity?
This will clear all your current label placements
and return all labels to the word bank.
